# dsh-usage-dashboard
**English** · 简体中文
A usage and cost dashboard for **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**: token and call counts broken down by proj
ect, provider and model, cost estimated from your local price config, and your DeepSeek account bala
nce — all on one screen inside *Settings → Usage & Cost*.
> Screenshots use **synthetic demo data** — no real account information.
## Features
- **Two primary KPIs plus one composition bar** — estimated cost, total tokens, and the input / outp

ut / cache-read split in a single glance.
- **Ranges** — Today, rolling 24H, 7D, 30D, 90D, All, cust

om. `24H` is a rolling window and is *not* the same as "today".
- **Three combinable filters** — pro

ject, provider, model. Click a provider row or a project row to drill in.
- **Trend chart** — toggle
between tokens and cost; toggle cache in or out (cache is usually >95% of all tokens, so hiding it

is the only way to see the input/output shape).
- **Provider breakdown** — input / output / cache /

call count per provider, with the bar segmented by composition.
- **Project table** — expand a row t

o see which providers that project used, with tokens and cost each.
- **Balance** — DeepSeek API-key

wallet and logged-in account wallet on separate rows, with top-up and bonus listed apart.
- **Float
ing card** — pinned bottom-right on the chat page, collapsed to a `Today ¥3.42 · 1.2M` pill; expand

for today's breakdown and balance. Draggable, position remembered.
- **Refresh policy** — refreshes
only when you open the settings page, expand the card, or click refresh. **No background polling**:
a full scan costs ~12s, so an idle page must not burn CPU. Data older than 10 minutes is dimmed as a
ts ~12s, so an idle page must not burn CPU. Data older than 10 minutes is dimmed as a staleness cue.
More screenshots
## Install
Requires a DSH build that ships the `dsh plugin` subcommand (tested on `0.2.1-rc.2`).
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Reload DSH, then open **Settings → Usage & Cost**.
Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-usage-dashboard`
## How the numbers are computed
These are deliberate honesty choices, and they matter more than the charts:
| Label | What it is | What it is *not* |
| **Estimated cost** | Per-token cost estimated from your local price config, including peak/off-pea

k bands | **Not a billed amount** — no billing records are read |
| **Plan value** | Subscription us
age valued at list prices, prefixed with `≈` | **Not money spent**, and never added to estimated cos

t |
| **Unpriced** | Models with no rule in the price config | **Not zero** — unpriced usage is coun

ted separately and never priced at 0 |
| **Calls** | Calls that carried a usage report | Failed or u

sage-less requests are not counted, so this can be lower than your provider's dashboard |
| **Balanc
e** | Account wallet balance | **Cannot be used to infer cumulative spend** — one balance is shared
by many keys/tools |

- **Currencies are never summed across** — each currency gets its own line.
- **Every view reconcile
s under the same filters** — KPIs, trend, provider ranking and project table all aggregate from one

filtered fact table, so totals and detail cannot disagree.
- **No data means no data** — an empty ra
nge renders an explicit empty state, not a flat zero chart.
## Privacy and network access
Everything this plugin does on your machine, in full:
1. **Reads local session logs** — scans `~/.dsh/sessions/**/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` (or `$DSH_HOME/se
ssions`) to extract per-call token usage. Conversation content is never uploaded and never copied in

to this plugin's output.
2. **Makes one balance request** — only if `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` is configured
, it calls `https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance` with that key. **That is the only host it ever co

ntacts**, and redirects are refused.
3. **Writes two files** — under `~/.dsh/storages/`: the scan ca
che and the price config. No session data is written.
No telemetry, no third-party reporting.
## Pricing config
Default rules live in `pricing.js`. To override, edit:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Per-provider peak/off-peak rates, currency and billing mode (`token` / `plan` / `subscription` / `un
known`) can be overridden. The file is validated before it is applied — invalid config is rejected r
ather than partially applied.
## Development
No dependencies; Node ≥ 22 only.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
- `client.js` is a build artifact and must stay committed — installing from git performs no build st

ep (`prepare` covers it anyway).
- Preview the sanitized screenshots with synthetic data (serve from

vers it anyway).
- Preview the sanitized screenshots with synthetic data (serve from the repo root):
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- Code layout:
- `usage.js` — parses session logs into an hourly fact table (tokens, call counts, co

st already computed)
- `view-model.js` — the single aggregation layer: time windows, granularity, co

mposable filters, period comparison
- `chart-kit.js` — components and design system (theme tokens on

ly; light and dark follow automatically)
- `client.js` — the browser half, generated by inlining the

two modules above
- `host.js` — the host half, registering the `/api/usage.dashboard*` endpoints
## Known limitations
- **A full scan takes ~10–15 s** (it replays every session log), so refresh happens on entry/expand/
manual only — no timer. If you leave the settings page open, the numbers stay frozen until you refre

sh.
- **Session counts are exact only without filters** — the host does not bucket sessions by time,

so that column shows `—` under a project/provider filter instead of a wrong number.
- **Balance is
DeepSeek-only** — `deepseek-official` (API-key wallet) and `deepseek-account` (logged-in wallet). Ot

her providers have no balance adapter.
- Weekly aggregation for 90D is implemented but needs enough
history to show more than one bar.
